data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, independently of others, and invite each Fisher02–25 to do so—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run optimality isn't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each: exact intended catch, and does it depend on others?
